sources.title: EnergyPlus Engineering Reference, Lookup Tables / Table:Lookup
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, EnergyPlus official documentation
sources.retrieval: official documentation index opened and full relevant lookup/linear interpolation text retrieved from indexed official page; direct section fetch had cache miss
sources.supports: Linear interpolation independently along each table axis; independent variables and data format must match the component model. Extrapolation is a separately configurable choice with possible domain limits.
sources.implementation: Within adjacent printed coordinates interpolate Q and P separately by nonnegative product weights, then derive COP=Q/P.
sources.our_conservative_policy_not_mandated_by_: No extrapolation; any missing required printed corner rejects lookup. No claim that DOE mandates this policy or that interpolation is field validation.
